item.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion
item.description:
Title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion
Genre: Action , RPG
Developer: CAPCOM Co., Ltd.
Publisher: CAPCOM Co., Ltd.
Franchise: Dragon's Dogma
Release Date: Oct 8, 2026




About This Content

Note: This product cannot be used without Dragon's Dogma 2.
Also, if needed, please update to the latest patch before playing.

Note: There are other set products which include this product. Please be aware of duplicate purchases.

Your unwritten epic begins.

Dragon's Dogma 2 presented players with a deep, explorable fantasy world, challenging them to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

With Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, that experience has been further enhanced through the addition of unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Experience enhanced gameplay.
Embark on uncharted adventures.
Enticing value for myriad additions.

Together with your loyal Pawns, set off on an unparalleled adventure!

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - New Content

1. New Stories Await in a Brand-New Area
Forsaken Dominion: Another Tale of Ruin Unfolds in the Snowy North

Adventure forth to the long-abandoned region of Norgan and join forces with the enigmatic Eir, who seeks to unravel the secrets of the undying Fallen Dragon. Unearth and appraise forgotten relics to unlock powerful new weapons and skills that will aid you on your journey.

2. New Challenges in the Main Area
Lost Rites: Prove Yourself with 12 Dungeon Challenges

Rare equipment once held by past Arisens lays dormant in the depths of freshly uncovered unique dungeons. Whether you want to sharpen your skills or lay claim to legendary treasures—test your mettle against the Pathfinder's trials.

3. More Variation in the Character Creator
New Hairstyles and Tattoos: Bring Your Characters to Life

Craft your Arisen and Pawns with precision using the new options added to the robust Character Creator. Find the style right for you and embark on a fresh new adventure.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 8500 / AMD Ryzen 5 3500
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT with 8GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Additional Notes: Supports 1080p gameplay (using upscaler)/45-60fps when selecting Prioritize Performance in Graphics Quality. Note: Frame rate may drop when the processing load is high. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6800 are required to support Ray Tracing. SSD recommended.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Super / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Additional Notes: Supports 1080p gameplay (using upscaler)/60fps when selecting Prioritize Performance in Graphics Quality. Note: Frame rate may drop when the processing load is high. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6800 are required to support Ray Tracing. SSD recommended.

item.title: Silver Pines
item.description:
Title: Silver Pines
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Wych Elm
Publisher: Team17
Release Date: Oct 8, 2026




About This Game

Find Eddie Velvet.

Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Embark on a journey filled with dread and atmosphere. Haunted by shadows of the past, Silver Pines is waiting to reveal its dark secrets.

***

A love letter to classic survival horror. Fight or avoid the horrors of the town as you scavenge for resources and solutions to the puzzles blocking your way.

***

Filled with locked doors and hidden paths, every turn holds an uncovered clue, a resource, or something waiting in the dark. With better tools and weapons more and more of the town becomes accessible.

***

The horrors of the town include a large variety of challenging monsters and hulking bosses that keeps every encounter tense and dangerous.

***

Inventory space is limited. Search everywhere for items because every bullet, bottle of medicine and upgrade matters.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game contains blood, violence, horror themes and general mature themes unsuitable for younger players.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NIVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 Ti, AMD Radeon R9 270X
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 5 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NIVIDIA GeForce GTX 770, AMD Radeon R9 380
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 5 GB available space

item.title: Order of the Sinking Star
item.description:
Title: Order of the Sinking Star
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Thekla, Inc.
Publisher: Arc Games , Gamirror Games
Release Date: Oct 8, 2026




About This Game

From legendary director Jonathan Blow ( Braid , The Witness ) comes Order of the Sinking Star , a massive puzzle adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. You are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. Explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide. As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world. Blending exploration, storytelling, and ever-progressing mechanics, Order of the Sinking Star invites you into a mysterious, living puzzle unlike anything you've played.

Master a Thousand Interwoven Challenges

Embark on an innovative puzzle adventure with dozens of game mechanics and hundreds of hours of unique gameplay. Each puzzle builds on the last, introducing new game mechanics that reward curiosity and persistence.

Choose Your Path, Roam at Your Pace

Explore four mysterious worlds, each with its own characters, rules, dangers, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Come and go as you like, you are free to take on the puzzles you discover at your own pace.

Take the Helm of Some Unlikely Heroes

A queen, a thief, a warrior, a wizard, and a talking boat are just some of the heroes of this tale. Each character wields complementary abilities and has captivating stories to tell.

Decipher an Epic Tale

As playable characters begin to meet and worlds collide, the mystery untangles. Through gameplay and notes you collect you learn more about this enigmatic realm. Piece by piece and clue by clue, you’ll uncover the secrets of the Order of the Sinking Star.

History, Foundation & Design Contributions

Order of the Sinking Star has been in the making for nearly a decade since the release of The Witness , born from a desire to push puzzle game design past its traditional limits to create the largest and greatest puzzle game ever made. With Order of the Sinking Star , the development team created a "game design supercollider" – smashing together the ideas from multiple puzzle game designers to create a puzzle landscape that's much more intricate and vast than what has come before.

The foundation of Order of the Sinking Star is built upon these four brilliant titles:

  • Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes by Alan Hazelden: A serene puzzle game about throwing stones into water to create stepping paths.

  • Mirror Isles by Alan Hazelden: A clever top-down game focused on swapping places with reflections across islands.

  • Promesst 1-3 by Sean Barrett: An abstract grid-puzzler about exploring a cave filled with mysterious beams of light.

  • Heroes of Sokoban ( 1 , 2 , & 3 ) by Jonah Ostroff: A fantasy-themed puzzle game where you manage distinct hero classes (like warriors and mages) with unique movement and pushing mechanics to reach the exit.

While these games inspire and comprise the very beginning of Order of the Sinking Star and lay the foundation of its gameplay, the game as a whole explores the endless, unexpected possibilities of merging these worlds together.

The game also showcases design contributions from Zach Polansky ( Enigmash ), Patrick Traynor ( Patrick's Parabox ), Marc ten Bosch ( Miegakure ), and several others – including design contributions from Twitch followers over the years.

The Thekla, Inc. team is incredibly thankful for all the support they’ve had for the game over the course of development!

item.title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
item.description:
Title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Gearbox Software
Publisher: 2K Games
Franchise: Risk of Rain
Release Date: Oct 8, 2026




About This Content


One must withstand suffering to learn true balance.
Delve deeper into the dark, cult-like world of N'kuhana in Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts.
Fight through haunting unexplored regions of Petrichor V, endure harrowing Trials, face horrific new enemies, and uncover powers never before possible in Risk of Rain 2.

Bring your friends on the adventure! Only one player is required to own Hallowed Concepts to enable the monsters, levels, and items to appear in-game for the whole lobby.
Players without the expansion will be unable to select the new survivors or permanently unlock new items, logbooks, or other content.


Acolyte dances across the battlefield, toying with her enemies and bargaining for more power with her own life force.
Combine close range glaive attacks with ranged strikes that chip away at an enemy's soul.
Fight well, and Ascend.
Enforcer holds the line or drives it forward with dynamic, tactical movement.
Create cover as a defensive vanguard.
Or dive straight into the heart of the action and decimate your enemies where they stand.
Endure the pain of the Winnowing of Survival.
Hunt your quarry to master the Winnowing of Predation.
Race against time and for your soul in the Winnowing of Mortality.


Discover and endure Hexes in exchange for Hallowed Items.

Find and Collect N'tormat Pages


Unlock the secrets of the new curio: the N'tormat.


Collect its pages to acquire powerful abilities, but at a cost.

item.title: Forever Ago
item.description:
Title: Forever Ago
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Third Shift
Publisher: Annapurna Interactive
Release Date: Oct 8, 2026




About This Game

Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends.

Discover Stories

Experience a nuanced and heartfelt story about broken dreams, loss, and regret—but also courage, hope, and true friendship. Learn about the stories, beliefs and struggles of characters you meet along the way, brought to life by renowned voice actors.

Embark on an Unforgettable Road Trip

Explore beautiful environments, ranging from serene forest trails to dusty barrens sweltering in the desert sun. Examine and interact with objects to learn about your surroundings and the people living there.

Capture Memories

Take pictures with Alfred’s good ol' instant camera to document your journey and solve small environmental puzzles.

Relive True Love

Play through a lifetime of love as Alfred with your sweetheart Audrey, experiencing a true love that transcends time. Featuring an original soundtrack by Clark Aboud (Slay the Spire, Kind Words).
